visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shows hands holding a spiral-bound sketchbook with watercolor paintings of landscapes. The background is a blurred outdoor setting with bright, natural daylight. (2) A young woman with dark hair, wearing a checkered sweater and sunglasses on her head, stands on a balcony. She holds the sketchbook and smiles at the camera. (3) The woman is then seen sitting in a vast field of pink and white cosmos flowers under a warm, late-afternoon sun. She is sketching attentively. (4) The setting shifts to the interior of a cafe with wooden furniture and warm lighting. She adjusts her hair and looks toward the window. (5) In a bright urban area, she stands in front of a yellow wall with large Chinese characters. She holds a small bag and a sketchbook, looking around. (6) A montage of her sketching various scenes follows: a red-roofed building, a wooden house, and a landscape with a windmill. Handheld camera movements emphasize the physical act of painting. (7) She walks across a city street and through a park with tall green trees. (8) She is shown on a walkway with a large white wind turbine spinning in the background against a hazy sky. (9) Finally, she sits by the coast at sunset, holding her sketchbook against the orange sky. Blue stylized text appears on a black screen at the very end.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 哇超醜的欸！這不知道長的什麼東西. [Logo]: 獨旅日記. (2) [Subtitle]: 那個...我很討厭寫生. (3) [Subtitle]: 但事實上，我是討厭那種不完美的感覺. (4) [Subtitle]: 對啦！頑固的土象星座就是最常見的完美主義者. [Variety]: 完美主義. (5) [Subtitle]: 也可以說...有點難搞（？）. (6) [Subtitle]: 我的水...水筆勒？. (7) [Subtitle]: 差點找不到...我每次都做...幹這種事情. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以這次獨旅，強迫結合寫生. (9) [Subtitle]: 試圖克服我內心的抗拒. (10) [Subtitle]: 用僅有的8個顏色，還有我最討厭的水彩. (11) [Subtitle]: 在隨身本上完成不同景點的寫生. (12) [Subtitle]: 台中天氣真的太好了. [Variety]: 台中. (13) [Subtitle]: 不愧是我的家鄉可愛～～. (14) [Subtitle]: 呃？呃...歌詞好像不是這樣唱哦？. (15) [Subtitle]: 那就來說說一個人旅行吧. (16) [Subtitle]: 我經常一個人走出大解放. (17) [Subtitle]: 甚至無拘無束的感受當下. (18) [Subtitle]: 那感覺真的很棒. (19) [Subtitle]: 回過頭來看，這次獨旅任務，其實是想讓我面對不舒適的感覺. (20) [Subtitle]: 管它舒不舒適，至少先擁抱這個不完美. (21) [Subtitle]: 至於...寫生對我來說還是很難. (22) [Subtitle]: 反正我試過了，下一次一定會更好！！！. [Logo]: 獨旅日記.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A personal travel vlog documenting the creator's journey to overcome her dislike of sketching and her perfectionist nature during a solo trip to Taichung.
